units: r_rho, v_dyn, t_dyn; rates and moments per dimensionless time
interpolation: Nonnegative multilinear mixture of full vertex jump rate measures; identical weights for rate,A,raw D and excluded flux; event vertex chosen proportional to weight times allowed rate
symmetry: Rate measures and moments averaged over the same physical symmetries; center velocity orientation is rotated from radial canonical law
holdout_interpretation: Moment checks do not establish full increment-law or residence convergence; grid sensitivity is tested through independent trajectory ensembles
